description: Audit-only finding: the per-braid mass tower implementation truncates at jet level n=0 only. Levels n=1, 2, ... are entirely unimplemented. The level-shift operator tau_hat_n that would generate level-(n+1) sub-braids from level-n is referenced in pentagon-uv-commutation.md but not yet realised in code.
verdict_detail: Current truncation N_implemented = 0. The mass-tower formula in pentagon-uv-commutation.md (lines 86-106) calls for sum over n=0..N, but no jet-level iteration exists in per_braid_tower_hybrid.py. Adding levels n>=1 requires first constructing the level-shift operator tau_hat_n, which is currently deferred per pentagon-uv-commutation.md:117.

current_truncation.method: single jet level n=0 with singletons (per-nucleon traces) and pairs (per-pair traces)
current_truncation.missing: all n >= 1 jet levels; tail bound R_N

label_clarification.code_label_Level_1: per-nucleon traces (singletons) at jet level n=0
label_clarification.code_label_Level_2: per-pair traces (pairs) at jet level n=0
label_clarification.note: The 'Level 1/2' labels in per_braid_tower_hybrid.py:90-94 refer to STRAND ARITY (1-strand vs 2-strand sub-braids), NOT the jet-level index n in the pentagon-uv-commutation formula. This is a confusing naming overlap.

mass_tower_formula.expression: m = |tr_M(W)| + sum_{n=0..N} ( sum_{xi in S_1^(n)} Phi_q(|tr_M(xi)|) + z^2 * sum_{(xi, xi') in S_2^(n)} Phi_q(|tr_M(xi*xi')|) ) + R_N
mass_tower_formula.key_property: Pentagon q-factor identity ensures no triples appear at any level; every triple absorbs to (pair + singleton) at level n plus residual at level n+1.

modules_audited.note: Computes desc + single + cross at level n=0 only. No outer loop over n.
Delegates to canonical pipeline (binding-canonical, markov-peel) for trace computation. No jet-level iteration.
Canonical Jones-Markov trace for the atom braid; no jet-tower expansion.

tau_hat_n.description: Level-shift operator that generates level-(n+1) sub-braids from level-n
tau_hat_n.reference: pentagon-uv-commutation.md:117 — 'deferred to the descent involution's quantization, where tau_hat_n is realized as a level-shift operator on A_{n+1} = A_n tensor Omega^1(A_n)'

level_n_sub_braids.description: Explicit braid words for jet-prolonged sub-braids xi at level n

estimated_level_1_size.method: Geometric tail bound from prop:jet-tower-convergence (not numerically pinned at q_0 in this audit)
estimated_level_1_size.rough_factor: ~0.066 of level-0 (per analogy with Sigma_all decay rate 0.2575^A from 2026-05-02-nv-frob-filter-conjectures.md)
estimated_level_1_size.expected_size_at_proton: ~few hundred ppm of base mass (comparable to current ~500 ppm proton residual)
estimated_level_1_size.note: Estimate is order-of-magnitude only; exact size requires actual level-1 computation, which requires tau_hat_n.

recommendation.next_step: Open a separate issue/branch to construct tau_hat_n (the level-shift operator referenced in pentagon-uv-commutation.md:117). Even a proton-scale realisation would unblock level-1 Phi_q evaluation.
recommendation.after_tau_hat_lands: Add a level-1 sum block to per_braid_tower_hybrid.py:90-141 (~5-line patch). Compare new per-atom residuals against current to confirm gap closes.
recommendation.alternative: Phenomenological proxy: derivative-prolongation of level-0 sub-braids in an explicit jet bundle. Less rigorous; faster to test.
